invariants.rationale: The context is used in the method; a null value would likely lead to a runtime exception.
instantTime is required to identify the commit instant, so it must not be null.
The preppedRecords list is expected to be processed; a null value would likely cause errors.
preppedRecords should always be a List, matching the method signature.
instantTime should not be an empty string since it is expected to denote a specific point in time.
